summary.intent: Execute Phase 23 (rust-sdk-extraction) using wave-based parallel execution to extract CipherBox cryptographic primitives, domain types, API client, filesystem abstractions, and SDK orchestration into a Cargo workspace with multiple crates.
summary.outcome: Waves 1 and 2 completed successfully (plans 23-01 through 23-03). Wave 3 was interrupted mid-execution by a usage limit reset; both agents (23-04 fuse crate, 23-05 sdk crate) created partial crate directory structures but did not commit. Wave 3 was re-spawned after resume, with the sdk crate partially completing several source files.

repo: Project uses a Cargo workspace structure with crates at `crates/{crypto,core,fuse,sdk,api-client}/`
Desktop app (Tauri) is being refactored from a monolith into a thin shell that imports from workspace crates
162 desktop tests existed before extraction; 12 new tests added in cipherbox-core crate
Platform-specific FUSE code is gated behind feature flags (macOS SMB backend, Linux FUSE, Windows)
Cross-language test vectors stored as JSON files for Rust/TypeScript parity testing

code.finding: Error types for sdk crate were partially created before usage limit hit
WriteQueue (offline write queue) extracted to sdk crate
Device registry operations extracted to sdk crate
Key material state management extracted to sdk crate
SyncDaemon (IPNS polling loop) extracted to sdk crate
Workspace root Cargo.toml was modified to register new crates

workflow: When agents hit usage limits mid-execution without committing, partial work persists as uncommitted files in the working tree — check for lib.rs and key module files to assess completion state
Re-spawning agents after usage reset picks up partial state; agents should detect existing partial work and continue rather than restart from scratch
Pre-wave dependency checks (verify key-links) are a useful gate before spawning dependent waves
Spot-checking for SUMMARY.md existence and git commits is reliable signal for agent completion

friction: Claude usage limit reset mid-wave-3 execution, interrupting both parallel agents before they could commit their work
Partial crate directories created without lib.rs files left repository in an inconsistent state requiring manual assessment before retry
No SUMMARYs created for 23-04 or 23-05 due to interruption, requiring orchestrator to diagnose state from filesystem and git log rather than structured output
